ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: "Ensemble Entrepreneurship." This course will prepare students to creatively develop, promote, and sustain performing ensembles such as duos, trios, quartets, quintets or larger collaborative mixed instrumental ensembles. Ancillary topics include event management (e.g. concerts, concert series, music festivals) and preparing professional portfolios. Presentations will utilize internal unit/college/campus expertise as well as industry and non-profit professionals from the wider music world.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Graduate, Junior, or Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
